findings.evidence: The ~11.1 GFLOP delta is arithmetic on Table 5‑1’s model-card rows, so it is [1P][DERIVED]; the open claim that remains [1P][HYPOTHESIS] is the separate one about whether the ~15% MAP uplift transfers to the target corpus.
findings.issue: The sentence labels the open transfer claim as [1P][HYPOTHESIS], but the preceding text explicitly says the ~15% MAP uplift is an [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] scenario input, not a first-party fact. Calling the transfer claim [1P][HYPOTHESIS] mixes provenance: the hypothesis is about an illustrative assumption, not about a first-party model-card value. This is a label/provenance mismatch that can mislead a reader into thinking the 15% figure has first-party provenance.
findings.fix_instruction: Change the label on the transfer claim to [ILLUSTRATIVE][HYPOTHESIS] (or otherwise state that the hypothesis concerns the [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] uplift), reserving [1P] for the model-card parameter and dimension rows only.
